cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a private present-day sleeper-train compartment beside a large window — waking from a nap and reaching to close the window blind as the train enters a station; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a stairwell landing with a tall window — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a far-future orbital visitor centre with a miniature rotating planetarium dome and an empty curved demonstration dais — taking a break by pretending to host the planetarium show; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a space-station lounge bar — seated on a chair; a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — lying on her left side; a walled garden with a lotus pond — sitting on the ground; a rocky waterfall pool under green trees — lying on her front; a castle courtyard rose garden around a stone fountain — sketches in a sketchbook and pencil; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; a Guan Yu temple — standing; a self-service car wash bay — holds a cup in both hands
